task: task-17 / Q5 advisory: flaky-headless find label assertion
assertion: edge-find-e2e.mjs: 'an already-labelled control keeps its click label' (exclusions.label.matches[0].label > 0)
classification: suite environment-dependence (headless window size), NOT an executor race and NOT a timing flake; fixed test-only in edge-find-e2e.mjs

mechanism.labelling: extension/sidepanel/browser.js ~line 1443: viewport-scoped by design — a control with rect.top > innerHeight - 1 is not labelled
mechanism.findLabelLookup: extension/sidepanel/find.js ~317-319: match keeps its label only if globalThis.__crazyagent.idsByElement has the element and byId maps back to it; find itself scans the whole DOM, so an unlabelled below-fold control still matches by accessible-name with label undefined
mechanism.fixtureGeometry: e2e/fixtures/find.html #control-input sits at rect.top 520 (constant across sizes; layout is width-independent at these sizes)
mechanism.headlessViewport: a --window-size=800,600 headless Edge yields innerHeight 516 (chrome subtracts ~84px); 520 > 515 so the control is below the fold and unlabelled. 1280x900 yields innerHeight 816 -> labelled (id 4).

beforeFix.failure: AssertionError: an already-labelled control keeps its click label

reproductionMatrix.note: fresh throwaway profile + free ports per run; headless=new; live extension tree. provider-fixer's 2 clean-HEAD failures are consistent with a launcher window <= ~520px viewport height (e.g. the headless default 800x600); harness-builder's earlier 5/5 green all used --window-size=1280,900.

fix.description: Pin the fixture page viewport to 1280x900 via CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride on the fixture tab target (connection kept open for the suite; survives the later canvas.html navigation). First attempt used chrome.windows.update(1280x900) but headless rejects out-of-screen bounds ('Bounds must be at least 50% within visible screen space') — recorded as a dead end.
fix.executorChange: none — viewport-scoped labelling is correct by design; browser.js untouched
